requirements.text: Substantial hands-on software development experience, with strong foundations in algorithms, data structures and software design.

You will collaborate with quantitative and engineering colleagues, applying strong software design, analytical and mathematical skills to systems that influence live research and trading decisions. The team welcomes strong candidates at different career stages.
A record of high achievement in computer science, mathematics, engineering or a related technical field.
The ability to collaborate clearly on complex technical problems and contribute to rigorous design decisions.
